title: Let's port Diablo to SerenityOS!
summary: Andreas Kling ports the game Diablo to SerenityOS, his from-scratch Unix-like operating system, using the devilutionX project. The roughly 80-minute session shows what porting third-party software to the OS involves.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a demonstration of SerenityOS's hackability and fast iteration across all layers of the system.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: the video on porting Diablo to SerenityOS in an hour is pretty interesting to watch
